subject.name: Peter Keating
subject.headline: Product/strategy builder turned early-stage AI investor at Interplay
subject.bio:
Peter's spent his career on the builder side of startups — first product hire at a crypto/web3 venture, corporate dev at an edtech scaleup, then three years running his own product strategy studio for early-stage founders. Now an MBA at NYU Stern and freshly landed as an Associate on the AI team at Interplay (VC + accelerator + studio + family office), plus a Venture Fellow sourcing and vetting deals for Stern's accelerator. He's straddling builder and investor identities right now, and clearly angling toward a full-time investing seat.</summary>
<parameter name="goals">Break in fully as a venture investor focused on early-stage AI and deep tech, build a reputation as a go-to sourcing/GTM resource for founders, expand a network of co-investors and operators for deal flow and diligence, eventually lead or co-lead seed checks
subject.offering: Hands-on product and GTM strategy advice for early-stage founders, startup sourcing and diligence support, connections into NYU Stern's accelerator pipeline and portfolio companies, first-hand builder-to-investor perspective
subject.looking_for: Introductions to early-stage founders (especially AI/deep tech), fellow investors and operators to swap deal flow and diligence notes with, and more senior VCs who can mentor him on the transition from operator to full-time investor

counterpart.name: Aditya Rangan
counterpart.headline: Co-founder & CEO, Trellis Labs — agentic workflow automation for insurance claims
counterpart.bio: Aditya was an engineering manager on the fraud platform at Marqeta before leaving in early 2024 to start Trellis Labs with his former colleague. He has no go-to-market background and has been running sales himself off a spreadsheet.

counterpart.looking_for: Concrete help sequencing an enterprise GTM motion for a two-engineer team, plus warm paths to seed funds that understand vertical AI in regulated industries.
